tasks.title: Add the Caddyfile, the Railway Dockerfile, and a container smoke test
tasks.description: Replace the Go app-shell/proxy server with Caddy. The Caddyfile serves the built static assets with an SPA fallback and reverse-proxies /api/* and /webhooks/resend/inbound to API_INTERNAL_URL. Railway terminates TLS, so bind :{$PORT} with auto_https off or Caddy will try to provision certificates and fail to bind. Add encode zstd gzip, which the Go http.FileServer never had. Note that Caddy's reverse_proxy preserves the original Host header whereas Go's NewSingleHostReverseProxy rewrites it to the target, so verify the behaviour in front of Rails rather than assuming it. The Dockerfile uses a Node build stage into a Caddy runtime with the repo root as build context, matching the deploy/ convention. This task does not switch the Railway service over.
acceptance_criteria: The Caddyfile binds :{$PORT} with auto_https off, serves static files with an SPA fallback, enables encode zstd gzip, and reverse-proxies /api/* and /webhooks/resend/inbound to API_INTERNAL_URL

Do not pass serviceWorkers:'block' to Playwright: it bypasses the caching path entirely, so a screenshot can look perfect while real returning browsers see something else. Reuse the Playwright browser already vendored under workers/node_modules.

tasks.title: Verify the Resend webhook path and the service worker handoff
tasks.description: Exercise the two production data paths the cutover cannot be allowed to break. First, prove a real or replayed Resend email.received survives Svix signature verification through Caddy into Rails, with the raw body and svix-* headers intact, and creates an InboundEmail. Svix verifies against the raw request body, so any proxy-layer body rewriting silently breaks ingestion. Second, prove the /app-worker.js kill switch actually retires the go-app worker: load the Go app first in a launchPersistentContext browser, then point it at the new build and confirm the old worker unregisters and its caches are cleared. Record both procedures and their results. No production Railway change.
acceptance_criteria: A real or replayed Resend email.received passes Svix verification through Caddy into Rails and creates an InboundEmail row

Both procedures and their results are recorded in docs/GO_MIGRATION.md, and the PWA-stuck manual fallback is documented in docs/PRODUCTION_SETUP.md
No Railway service or variable is changed by this task

docs/PRODUCTION_SETUP.md documents the manual post-cutover check on the owner iOS home-screen web app as the real gate, plus the delete-and-re-add fallback and what it costs: the session cookie, the push subscription, and the waunder.layout and waunder.jobFilters values
